o: In its most treacherous season yet, The Traitors returns to Ardross Castle, where a fresh lineup of reality heavyweights descend into a game of secrets, sabotage, and psychological warfare. Host Alan Cumming presides over every twist with theatrical menace as Faithfuls hunt for hidden Traitors and Traitors quietly pick them off one by one. Alliances crumble, paranoia surges, and one shocking…

eps.t: Let the Cards Fall As They Will
eps.o: Another new all-star cast arrives in Scotland at night and the game starts faster than ever before.
Some overwhelming evidence is brought to the roundtable; the Traitors must murder in plain sight.
The Faithful are given a chance for vengeance; the mission results in a brutal end for one player.

eps.t: Cut the Head Off the Snake
eps.o: A fiery mission results in several players up for murder; there's a big swing at the roundtable.

eps.t: If You're Gonna Come for Me, I'll Finish You
eps.o: The mission offers the chance to stop the night's murder, but only if the Faithful stick together.
The roundtable brings difficult decisions and the Traitors must pull off the bloodiest murder.
A bloody banquet shakes the castle while Traitor trust teeters; one player wins a great power.

eps.t: A Queen Never Comes Off Her Throne
eps.o: A strategic murder shakes the castle and alliances are tested; heat rises between the Traitors.
While a new alliance is tested, suspicions force an old one into the spotlight.
With a place in the final at stake, emotions run high as friendships are tested to their limits.
Doubt and paranoia run through the castle as attempts are made to sway players' allegiances.
Host Andy Cohen talks with the Season 4 cast of "The Traitors" about their time in the castle.
